issue.title: How do you add a shorthand to an option?
issue.body:
You would like to add a shorthand to an option.

How would you add a shorthand to an option (e.g., `f` in `--flag`)?

comments.author: marckhouzam
comments.body:
For example
localCmd.Flags().StringVarP(&Source, "source", "s", "", "Source directory to read from")

Notice the “s” parameter
